rationale: The workflow already implements the optimizations supported by the retrieved evidence. Rust dependency caching is present in every Rust job via actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain cache-workspaces (test, compat, ffi, musl, features, wasm, clippy), satisfying P-LIT-GHA-CACHE's dependency-cache mechanism, so an equivalent cache already exists. The ffi job additionally caches Conan packages via actions/cache/restore and actions/cache/save. Concurrency cancellation for superseded PR runs is already configured at the workflow level (cancel-in-progress for pull_request). The remaining candidate, P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (changing fail-fast from false to true on the test/compat/ffi matrices), is not suitable: the complete sentinel job requires all matrix jobs and treats cancelled results as failure, meaning every matrix outcome is required, which is an explicit contraindication of that pattern. Enabling fail-fast would also cancel remaining cross-platform matrix cells on a failure, reducing diagnostic coverage rather than preserving intended build and test coverage. The fail-fast evidence is synthetic with minimal measured savings and carries branch-protection/required-check safety caveats needing separate review.
